radius.$description: One corner scale for every component inside a theme boundary, from none to xl, and the roles that name a step of it. The full corner, half the tallest single-line control, is a calculation DTCG cannot hold and stays in TokensHandwritten.css as --env-radius-full.

sm.$description: Small corners: buttons in a group, chips, menu rows, list rows inside a surface.

lg.$description: Medium corners: fields, tables, alerts and other blocks.

surface.$description: The rounded corners of surfaces, dialogs and popups.
